_comment: Mid-battle fog of war transitions recorded as a replay track (#1579). Staged: player Spearmen (uid 0, at 500, 500, foot sight 15 m = 300 wu) and enemy Archers (uid 1, at 1100, 500, 600 wu east, outside foot sight). Fog starts off so both units are visible. Tick 30: F7 toggles fog of war on -- the distant enemy Archers vanish and the HUD displays the FOG OF WAR status indicator. Tick 60/80: select the Spearmen and order an advance eastward toward (1000, 500); as the gap closes, fog remains active and unrevealed enemies stay hidden. Tick 320: F7 toggles fog of war off -- full battlefield visibility is restored and the HUD indicator disappears. The mid-battle toggles are recorded into the replay event track and reproduced deterministically on playback.
